events_seen: FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 04 (2 days ago)): Brent added Brycen Tremayne (WR, CAR).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 04 (2 days ago)): Mitchum added Jacob Cowing (WR, SF).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 04 (2 days ago)): Drew added Tyler Goodson (RB, DAL) (dropped Emari Demercado (RB, DAL)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 03 (3 days ago)): Ryan added Devontez Walker (WR, BAL).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 03 (3 days ago)): Ryan added British Brooks (RB, HOU).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 03 (3 days ago)): Ryan added Julian Hill (TE, NE).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 03 (3 days ago)): Ryan added Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF) (dropped Odell Beckham (WR, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 02 (4 days ago)): Adam added Tyler Higbee (TE, LAR).

WEEK 4 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Brent, 139.7-131.1; Jake def. Adam, 122.9-109.6; Wingard def. Drew, 104.0-93.1; Shaq def. Fronge, 138.3-119.6; Charles def. Ryan, 162.2-138.9; Mitchum def. Kevin, 187.8-133.8 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Adam situation at $79.57 and 2-6 is the part of this week I keep coming back to. HLX was the market's favorite redemption story in the preseason. The preseason ended. Helix Quant added Tyler Higbee off waivers and that is where the turnaround narrative currently lives.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Ryan added four free agents in two days — Walker, Brooks, Hill, Robinson — and dropped Odell Beckham in the process. That is a lot of activity from a team at 4-4 staring down a Week 5 matchup against Wingard. The question is whether any of those moves actually close the gap that a 162-138 loss to Charles opened.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Terrence picking the chalk after going 5-7 is not a strategy, it is self-preservation. The Ledger will have the full pick-em accountability section this week and the bottom of that board is going to be a very uncomfortable place to sit.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Going 5-7 on the season and taking my lumps publicly. That said — I will have Mitchum-Charles this week and I am not fading the 8-0 team. Crownline at $136.79 is the market-cap leader for a reason and I am done finding creative ways to pick against Charles until the scoreboard gives me a reason.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS 0-8. ATLAS IS AT $49.72. WINGARD BEATS THEM 104-93 AND SDR AT $65.03 IS CELEBRATING A WIN OVER THE CHEAPEST LISTING IN EXCHANGE HISTORY. I NEED SOMEONE TO EXPLAIN TO ME WHAT THE WEEK 5 DREW-FRONGE GAME ACTUALLY MEANS FOR EITHER FRANCHISE BECAUSE RIGHT NOW I SEE TWO ORGANIZATIONS FIGHTING OVER DRAFT POSITION AND CALLING IT A RIVALRY.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Corbishley as the steadiest desk in the league three windows ago and the scoreboard at 7-1 with $123.00 on the exchange is doing my argument for me. Jake is a dangerous draw in Week 5 — ECHO's RB backfield is elite and Corbishley's QB room has a depth question that one bad snap makes urgent.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: The Charles-Mitchum matchup this week is the best game on the slate and it is not particularly close. The only 8-0 team in the league hosting — sorry, facing — the guy who just dropped 187 on Kevin. 710 points of force meets the hottest scorer of the week. I am circling this one.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Mitchum scored 187.8 points in a week where Deepwater had no flagship direction and the board wanted a buy-sell call. DEEP is at $82.86 and rising. At some point the market stops calling it a drift and starts calling it a run.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I want a segment where we put the Week 5 board up and talk about the Corbishley-Jake matchup for twenty uninterrupted minutes. APEX at $123.00 is climbing. ECHO at $104.02 is climbing. One of those stocks takes a hit on Sunday and I want to be on record before the coin lands.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tuesday morning and the board is fully digested. Charles is 8-0. Mitchum is 6-2 with a 187-point explosion on his résumé. And Ryan just lost to the undefeated team while AEGIS sits at $127.96. The Ledger is going to be a long read this week.
